items.author: Austin Krell
items.body_excerpt:
Greetings from Delaware, where Labaron Philon, Jr., Justin Edwards, and Rayan Rupert are playing for the Blue Coats.

Rupert has all 5 for the Coats, who are trailing by 13 early on to the Maine Celtics. VJ Edgecombe is here to support his teammates.
